verdict.rationale: Framer documents its own public Server API to 'connect your product and automate publishing'. It also documents a native external-agent connection that lets Claude Code, Cursor and Codex read and write the canvas and CMS, with changes landing on a branch. However, the pack shows only one-line descriptions of the Server API, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec, so the API's documented depth and full coverage of product operations are unproven. Missing for 10: detailed Server API reference (endpoints, auth, scope of operations), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Server API Connect your product and automate publishing with the Framer API.
Use the Server API to bring Framer into your product, or connect an external agent to work on a Framer project from the tools you already use.
Once connected, the agent can read and write CMS collections, including creating, updating, and deleting items.
the native Framer External Agent connection gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex... direct access to your canvas, components, CMS, and project context
